legal_units.title: Effect of order of tribunal or court in respect of business reorganisation.
legal_units.text: Irrespective of anything to the contrary contained in section 263, if prior to the date of order in respect of business reorganisation, any return of income has been furnished under the provisions of the said section by an entity for any tax year to which such order applies, the successor shall furnish, within six months from the end of the month in which the order was issued, a modified return in such form and manner, as may be prescribed, in accordance with and limited to the said order.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 314 Effect of order of tribunal or court in respect of business reorganisation. Section 314(1): Irrespective of anything to the contrary contained in section 263, if prior to the date of order in respect of business reorganisation, any return of income has been furnished under the provisions of the said section by an entity for any tax year to which such order applies, the successor shall furnish, within six months from the end of the month in which the order was issued, a modified return in such form and manner, as may be prescribed, in accordance with and limited to the said order.

legal_units.title: Effect of order of tribunal or court in respect of business reorganisation.
legal_units.text: Where the assessment or reassessment proceedings for a tax year to which the order in respect of the business reorganisation applies,—

legal_units.title: Effect of order of tribunal or court in respect of business reorganisation.
legal_units.text: Subject to any other provisions of this section, in an assessment or reassessment made in respect of a tax year under this section, all other provisions of this Act shall apply and the tax shall be chargeable at the rate or rates as applicable to such tax year.

legal_units.title: Effect of order of tribunal or court in respect of business reorganisation.
legal_units.text: For the purposes of this section,—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 314 Effect of order of tribunal or court in respect of business reorganisation. Section 314(4): For the purposes of this section,—

legal_units.title: Effect of order of tribunal or court in respect of business reorganisation.
legal_units.text: "business reorganisation" means the reorganisation of business involving the amalgamation or demerger or merger of business of one or more persons;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 314 Effect of order of tribunal or court in respect of business reorganisation. Section 314(4): For the purposes of this section,— Section 314(4)(a): "business reorganisation" means the reorganisation of business involving the amalgamation or demerger or merger of business of one or more persons;

legal_units.title: Effect of order of tribunal or court in respect of business reorganisation.
legal_units.text: "order in respect of business reorganisation" means an order of a High Court or tribunal or an Adjudicating Authority as defined in section 5(1) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (31 of 2016); and
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 314 Effect of order of tribunal or court in respect of business reorganisation. Section 314(4): For the purposes of this section,— Section 314(4)(b): "order in respect of business reorganisation" means an order of a High Court or tribunal or an Adjudicating Authority as defined in section 5(1) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (31 of 2016); and

legal_units.title: Effect of order of tribunal or court in respect of business reorganisation.
legal_units.text: "successor" means all resulting companies in a business reorganisation, whether or not the company was in existence prior to such business reorganisation.
